claims.text: Almost nothing supports the claim that it was a Wednesday.
A different weekday could only arise from calendar-system errors such as applying the Julian calendar.
Britain and its colonies abandoned the Julian calendar in 1752.
Britain and its American colonies used the Gregorian calendar by 1776, so the date is Gregorian.
Under the Doomsday method, July 11 is a doomsday in common years.
The doomsday for 1776 is Thursday, so July 11, 1776 was a Thursday.
July 4 is seven days before July 11, so it fell on the same weekday, Thursday.
The Thursday result matches the widely cited historical record.
The Julian-calendar possibility does not apply because the colonies had switched to Gregorian.
